description: Enumerate the reference vocabulary this server uses: BCD namespaces, BCD browser ids, browserslist agent ids and their BCD counterparts, Baseline states, web-features groups, and ECMAScript snapshots. Use it to build valid inputs for the other tools and to see which target browsers can be evaluated.

topic.description: Which vocabulary to list: bcd_namespaces for the 12 top-level browser-compat-data namespaces, bcd_browsers for the 17 tracked browsers, browserslist_agents for the 19 browserslist ids mapped to browser-compat-data browsers, baseline_states for the 4 Baseline states, groups for the 104 web-features groups, or snapshots for the 11 ECMAScript snapshots.

name: browsercompat_list_reference

attribution.description: Required attribution for the caniuse-derived usage figures in this response.

data_version.description: Vintage of each bundled dataset behind this answer.

bcd_generated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the browser-compat-data snapshot was generated at.

browserslist.description: Version of the bundled browserslist query resolver.

caniuse_lite.description: Version of the bundled caniuse-lite snapshot.

web_features.description: Version of the bundled web-features snapshot.

entries.description: Every entry in the requested vocabulary.

bcd_browser.description: browser-compat-data browser this browserslist agent maps to, or null when none exists.

count.description: How many items the entry covers — compat keys for a namespace or Baseline state.

detail.description: One line explaining what the entry covers.

id.description: Identifier callers pass to the other tools, or filter results by.

maps_from.description: Raw web-features status.baseline value this reported state maps from; null for not_mapped, which has none.

reported.description: True when this browser is in the reported set (desktop or mobile). Runtimes are added only by include_runtimes.

spec_url.description: Specification URL for this ECMAScript snapshot.

usage_percent.description: Share of tracked global traffic attributed to this browserslist agent.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

title: Browsercompat List Reference
